meta_description: Call Electrical in Liverpool provides domestic and commercial electrical installation, repair, and maintenance. Fast, reliable service across Merseyside. Call now.

services.title: Emergency Electrical Repairs

services.title: Commercial Electrical Maintenance

about_pullquote: I started this business because I hated cowboys overcharging people in Liverpool.
about_para_1: Call Electrical has been serving Liverpool and Merseyside for 18 years. We began as a one-man operation and have grown to a trusted team handling domestic rewires, emergency callouts, and commercial projects. Every electrician on our books is fully trained and NICEIC approved, so you know the work meets strict safety standards.
about_para_2: Customers come back to us because we turn up on time, explain what's wrong in plain English, and give honest quotes with no nasty surprises. We don't charge call-out fees and we work flexibly — early mornings, late evenings, and weekend callouts all covered. Reputation is everything in this trade, and ours speaks for itself across Clubmoor, Walton, and beyond.
reviews_heading: What Liverpool Homeowners Say About Call Electrical

reviews.text: Had a nightmare with a faulty socket that was sparking. Called Call Electrical on a Saturday afternoon and they were here within the hour. Sorted it straight away, really professional and fair price. Can't fault them. Will use again without question.
reviews.author: Marcus T.

reviews.text: Complete rewire of our old Edwardian terrace. The quote was competitive and the lads were tidy, on time, and explained everything as they went. No mess left behind either. Proper job. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Angela M.

reviews.text: Emergency call at 11pm because we'd lost power in the kitchen. They came out, diagnosed a loose connection, had us back up and running in 20 minutes. No faffing about, no inflated bill. Exactly what you want in an emergency.
reviews.author: David K.
